note: Baked world-space routes with floor heights. Do not edit by hand; re-run the bake tool when the level changes.

daniel_dock_to_basement.note: Daniel's walk-in: as Arthur's, then through the hall and down the spiral stairs to the basement, where he stays (DANIEL_IN_BASEMENT).

hall_to_launch_berth.note: Arthur from the hall to the player's launch berth (the north jetty), for boarding (T11).

hall_to_porch.note: Inside the door (the hall) back out to the porch.

porch_to_hall.note: The porch to the hall spot inside the door.

sailors_dock_to_hall.note: Arthur's walk-in: the dock, the stairs, the porch, through the door into the hall (SAILORS_INSIDE).

sailors_dock_to_porch.note: From the south jetty (the rowboat's berth) up the stone stairs and across the plateau to the lighthouse porch.

ted_to_lamp.note: Ted from the greeting spot behind the front door up the tower stairs to his spot beside the arc lamp (he walks it while he sends the player to the coal).
